items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: Mr. Galga, Mr. Sheen. What's up? Galga, Mr. Sheen. Come out in the early twas.

ctx.x: Well, she has a love with one of his tunes. Uh, and we were like, oh, when I... Uh, Mr. Galga, Mr. Sheen. What's up? Galga, Mr. Sheen. Come out in the early twas. Mr. Galga, Mr. Sheen. Um, Black Snake Rouge. He's like, Mary. Yeah, they have a girl. And a lot of old standards. But he clearly knows. He has a love.

What do you play the... You know when you play, you record, make that record with, uh, Howard. And they play that and you guys have it again. Is that the way Chris played that? Yeah, I think it was Chris did. And then it would have a smooth introduction. Yes. And then it would have a smile. But the eye of Chris, Chris would, uh, use a silver mute.
